bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs, springboard/proto/src/lib.rs, springboard/core/src/force_effect.rs, springboard/core/src/rumble.rs, springboard/src/bare/pad_rumble.rs, springboard/src/bare/vibrator.rs, springboard/src/shell/services/gamepad_service.rs, springboard/sdk/src/system_sound.rs
summary: Haptic pulse patterns and game controller rumble exist as pure models, a vibrator check drives one Settings row, and the SDK sends a one-shot haptic request. No app can build or play a haptic pattern, and the shell has no handler for the one-shot request on this branch, so the request does nothing. Core Haptics is iOS 13.0 and later per the index and is Apple's haptic motor API, not a tablet framework of its own.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.apple: UIFeedbackGenerator, prepare(), impact, selection and notification generators
features.note: the SDK sends a parameterless request; no shell code handles tag 0x105 on this branch, so the pulse is not played
three patterns with strengths and durations in a pure model; nothing drives the device with them

features.feature: Haptic engine connection and pattern player
features.note: no engine object for apps; no start, stop or reset of a pattern

features.feature: Transient and continuous events with parameter curves
features.note: the force-effect model has an envelope and constant, periodic, ramp and condition effects, but no event list and no real-time parameters

features.apple: AHAP files, CHHapticPattern from a file

features.note: system sounds state that they carry no vibration; no audio resource with a haptic track

features.apple: Playing haptics on game controllers with Core Haptics
features.note: two-motor rumble effect uploaded to the controller's input node and played or stopped; no pattern player
checks two sysfs nodes; the answer only decides whether the Keyboard Haptics switch is offered

gaps: The one-shot haptic request reaches no motor: the shell has no handler for it on this branch.
No haptic engine or pattern player for apps, and no AHAP file format.
No event parameters or real-time parameter curves for apps.
The vibrator check looks only at two sysfs nodes; the tablet's motor is not tested on hardware.
